text: Yours is in tonight's run, dear. I saved it for last.
delivery: mild and pleasant, like a librarian mentioning an overdue book
style: Retired county clerk in her sixties, now director of a Montana records archive. Consistent Western American (Montana) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, warm pitch; unhurried, exact, kind in tone. She never raises her voice and never hurries; the kindness is the dangerous part.
